name: Atmos Yoga
summary: Discover tranquility with atoms yoga, your ultimate VR yoga experience on Meta Horizon. Dive into guided yoga sessions designed for all levels, from beginners to seasoned yogis, in stunning virtual environments that enhance relaxation and mindfulness. With immersive yoga practices, customizable sessions, and a user-friendly interface, atoms yoga helps you reduce stress, improve flexibility, and find balance. Perfect for fitness and wellness enthusiasts, this app transforms your Meta Quest into a serene yoga
